description: This walk takes you along a section of the South West Coast Path from Babbacombe to Teignmouth via Shaldon. The route runs for 6.6 miles, following the undulating cliff top path. Along the way you will enjoy some fabulous views over Babbacombe Bay before coming to the ferry at Shaldon. This will take you over the River Teign to Teignmouth where the walk finishes. Highlights include Babbacombe's clifftop green at Babbacombe Downs. From here Oddicombe Beach is accessed via Babbacombe Cliff Railway. At the other end of the walk there's fine views over the Teign estuary and the lovely Teignmouth Beach. The long, sandy beach that stretches from the mouth of the River Teign eastward towards Dawlish. You can continue your walk along the Teignmouth to Dawlish Railway Walk. See the Torquay Walks for more walking ideas in the area.
